description: This is a Java source file implementing the TicketDAO interface. It contains methods for CRUD operations on Ticket entities using Hibernate ORM in a Spring application.

classes.name: TicketDAOImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for Ticket entity, providing CRUD operations with Hibernate and Spring integration.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates a Ticket object in the database; retrieves existing Ticket details if ID exists and updates the creation date accordingly.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all Ticket entities from the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a Ticket from the database based on its ID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a Ticket by its ID.

methods.name: getTicketByTicketid
methods.description: Fetches a Ticket using a ticket ID, returning the first match.

methods.name: getListBasedOnUserId
methods.description: Returns a list of Tickets associated with a specific user ID.
